title: Roasted Mediterranean Salad
description: A flavorful salad featuring roasted vegetables and a mix of fresh greens.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: mix of zucchini, bell peppers, and eggplant

instructions: Toss the zucchini, bell peppers, and eggplant with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the lettuce and roasted vegetables.
Drizzle the mediterranean salad dressing over the top and toss to combine.
